entities.name: Woodhead Commission
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Woodhead Commission was a British technical commission established to propose "a detailed" partition scheme for Mandatory Palestine, including recommending the partition boundaries and examination of economic and financial aspects of the Peel Plan.
